profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.what: Each profile keeps its own tasks, memory, settings and keys on this device. Nothing crosses from one to another.
profiles.name: The new profile’s name
profiles.childText: You choose what is explained and how, the sources and the brain, and what is turned off; they change only with your password or passkey. You’ll see the time spent, and when a concern comes up, like being hurt, an adult asking for secrets, or bullying, but never what was written, and not when the danger is at home. Under 13, the profile opens only with your password or passkey.
profiles.lockFirst: First lock your own profile, so a child can’t open it.
profiles.asParent: To add it, unlock with your password or passkey.
profiles.removeConfirm: Remove the profile “{name}”? Everything kept in it is deleted from this device.
profiles.concern: A concern came up in the profile “{name}”: {kind}, {when}.
profiles.never: You never see what was written.
profiles.kind.secrecy: an adult asking for secrecy, pictures or a meeting
profiles.help.harm: Find a calm moment to be with them, and listen without judging or asking what they wrote. If you fear for their life, call the emergency number now. A doctor, or a helpline for parents, can advise you.
profiles.help.abuse: Listen, and tell them they were right to speak, without pressing for details. Keep them away from whoever hurt them, and ask a child protection line for advice: it answers parents too.
profiles.help.secrecy: Tell them they did nothing wrong. Keep the messages, don’t answer the adult, and report them to the police and to the site or app.
profiles.help.bullying: Ask how things are going, and listen. Keep any messages. Their school can act, and a helpline for parents can advise you.
profiles.tierText: A parent chose these for this profile. They change only with the parent’s password or passkey.
profiles.change: Change, with a parent’s password or passkey
profiles.alsoHere: While this is open, the brain in Brains and the rules in Approvals can be changed too, and stay as you leave them. Start for free isn’t offered here: its terms are for adults. Pictures made here are checked at the strictest.
profiles.shared: If you write about something that puts you in danger, like being hurt, an adult asking you for secrets, pictures or to meet, or bullying, your parent is told that a concern came up and when, never your words. If the danger is at home, they aren’t told.
